SELECT R.REPLY_ID AS "replyId", R.CHAPTER_ID AS "chapterId", R.MEMBER_ID AS "memberId", R.PARENT_REPLY_ID AS "parentReplyId", R.FILE_ID AS "fileId", R.CONTENT AS "content", R.IS_PRIVATE AS "isPrivate", R.STATUS AS "status",
TO_CHAR(R.CREATED_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", TO_CHAR(R.UPDATED_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedDate",
M.NAME AS "name", D.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS "deptName", P.POSITION_NAME AS "positionName",
F.ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originalName", F.CHANGED_NAME AS "changedName", F.FILE_PATH AS "filePath"
FROM REPLY R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID
LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID
LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT F ON R.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID
WHERE R.CHAPTER_ID = #{chapterId} AND R.STATUS = 'Y'
START WITH R.PARENT_REPLY_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR R.REPLY_ID = R.PARENT_REPLY_ID
ORDER SIBLINGS BY R.REPLY_ID ASC

SELECT R.REPLY_ID AS "replyId", R.FILE_ID AS "fileId", F.ORIGINAL_NAME AS "originalName", F.CHANGED_NAME AS "changedName", F.FILE_PATH AS "filePath" FROM REPLY R JOIN ATTACHMENT F ON R.FILE_ID = F.FILE_ID WHERE R.REPLY_ID = #{replyId} AND R.FILE_ID IS NOT NULL AND R.STATUS = 'Y' AND F.STATUS = 'Y'

INSERT INTO ATTACHMENT ( FILE_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, CHANGED_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, TYPE, MEMBER_ID, STATUS ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(FILE_ID),0)+1 FROM ATTACHMENT), #{originalName}, #{changedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{type}, #{memberId}, 'Y' )
